channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Royce O'Neale | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Royce O'Neale from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Royce O'Neale
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Royce O'Neale:

“I think he's on the court. I think tomorrow is 10 days, kind of re-evaluate, update. He's progressing kind of as we hoped or expected. So I think I don't have anything past really that. But I think we're encouraged with how he's progressing”

Mike Budenholzer on Royce O'Neale, Jan 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Sean Marks on Royce O'Neale
item.description:
Sean Marks on Royce O'Neale amid the KD news:

“We are excited to welcome Royce and his family to Brooklyn. He is a versatile wing defender and floor spacer whose tenacious style of play fits the fabric of the team we are building.”

Sean Marks on Royce O'Neale, Jun 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Royce O'Neale
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell, on Royce O’Neale’s contract extension:

“It’s great to see great things happen to great people. ... We all know the worker he is, the time and effort he puts in. You guys have seen the effort, you guys have seen the results.”

Donovan Mitchell on Royce O'Neale, Jan 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.
